title: Ah poveretto me!
subtitle: Guglielmo, Don Alfonso and Ferrando: recitative from Così fan tutte, Act 2

licences.source: W. A. Mozart, Così fan tutte, K. 588 (1790), Act 2 scene 13, recitative between No. 29 and No. 30
licences.author: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart (1756–1791)

licences.source: Lorenzo Da Ponte, libretto of Così fan tutte (1790)
licences.author: Lorenzo Da Ponte (1749–1838)
licences.notes: Words as printed in the Peters vocal score (Ah poveretto me, where the libretto has Oh; Dov' è, dell' Inferno, com' elle and un' ottava as two words; pur troppo as two words; l'eccezzione; spennacchiate; vo without an apostrophe). Don Alfonso's potea is printed “po-te_a”, its last two syllables on one note.

licences.source: Edition Peters vocal score (Edition Peters Nr. 4474, plate 11446, edited by Georg Schünemann), pages 305–308, the recitative between No. 29 and No. 30 (54 bars)
licences.author: Kurt Soldan (1891–1946), piano reduction
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: sung lines and piano each read by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the page by a judge, a separate sweep for marks, then checked bar by bar by a fresh checker (clean). Where the print gives a second rhythm for the German words, notes that carry only a German syllable are left out and the Italian rhythm is kept. The German singing translation is left out. Bar 13 adds up to only three and a half beats in the print; an eighth rest before Guglielmo's “Dov'” fills it. The print's footnote says that this recitative is missing from the autograph and follows a manuscript in the Istituto musicale in Florence. It ends “segue Nr. 30. Andante”. Playback tempo: Free, as recitative is sung: played here at a speaking pace, ♩ = 98, from Jacobs (2:12).
